The history of the Vythzkel of city game
The game opens onto a universe unlike any other, a world where there's no fighting or shooting or anything else, just simple, calm gameplay. Discover the atmosphere of the game's setting and follow the dialogue of the characters in the game's houses.


🎮 Controller Configuration – Vythzkel: Of City Dynasty

In Vythzkel: Of City Dynasty, controller gameplay is designed to provide a smooth and natural experience. Every action is quickly accessible, allowing players to build, explore, and manage their city in a relaxed atmosphere.

🌆 Vythzkel: Of City Dynasty

Vythzkel: Of City Dynasty is a gaming experience designed to offer a moment of calm, creativity, and escape. In this soothing universe, you are invited to build, develop, and contemplate your own city in the heart of a rich and atmospheric world.

Far from the pressure and speed of traditional games, Vythzkel offers an adventure focused on relaxation and natural progression. Every street, every building, and every neighborhood you create contributes to the birth of a unique city, shaped by your decisions and your imagination.

In this peaceful world, players take the time to observe, explore, and build a true urban dynasty, where the balance between development and harmony becomes the key to prosperity.

🌿 A relaxing and immersive experience

Vythzkel was designed as a digital refuge, a place where players can immerse themselves in a calm and contemplative atmosphere.

The environments are designed to convey a sense of serenity. The warm lights of the houses, the open landscapes, and the soft colors create the ideal setting to relax after a long day.

The experience encourages a natural pace:

you take the time to explore, think about the layout of your city, and observe the life that develops there.

In Vythzkel, there is no rush. Every moment is an invitation to enjoy the journey.

Here's to this game!
